title: A contact-geometric variant of Smale's contraction
summary: Motivated by Smale's contraction of the compactly supported diffeomorphism group of the two-disc, we study contact forms on an open rotationally symmetric Darboux ball that agree with the standard contact form outside a compact set and whose Reeb flows have no trapped orbits. Such forms are called vertically convex. In dimensions three and five, we identify the quotient of their space by compactly supported diffeomorphisms with a contractible monodromy space and prove an equivariant product splitting.
